faq.q: How much does Andy Van Le & Associates, PC Law Center charge?
faq.a: Andy Van Le & Associates, PC Law Center publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Andy Van Le & Associates, PC Law Center offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Andy Van Le & Associates, PC Law Center publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Andy Van Le & Associates, PC Law Center have offices?
faq.a: Andy Van Le & Associates, PC Law Center publishes one office, in San Diego. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Andy Van Le & Associates, PC Law Center?
faq.a: Andy Van Le & Associates, PC Law Center names six attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
